what_works: Numbered project grid (1-23) with monospace counters acts as a 'system at work' visual cue — same trick lets a younger contractor frame jobs as 'Job #047 / completed' rather than generic testimonials. Electric-blue link state is the only color in the layout.
what_does_not_translate: Interaction-designer level micro-animations would tank Lighthouse on mobile — borrow the numbered system, skip the animations.
type_observations: Monospace numerals + grotesk body; numbers and labels are the same height as adjacent body text — the system reads as 'engineered', not 'designed'.
